lens: statistics/methodology (does the design support the claim)
central_claim: In public data, computed evidence for a class-inherited FET-fusion -> impaired-ATM -> compensatory-ATR-dependency hypothesis transferring to EMC is weak-to-absent: EMC tumour transcriptomes show only generic proliferation (WEAK tier), cell-line CRISPR and drug-response instruments cannot discriminate the mechanism from adjacent DDR biology, and a new ATM-genotype stratification of the same GDSC2 residual space used by Part D fails to detect even the field-standard BRCA2/PARP-inhibitor pairing at these arm sizes, so Part D's ATM null is correctly downgraded from NEGATIVE to UNINFORMATIVE.

p1s.summary: The BRCA2/PARP-inhibitor 'machinery control' is described as 'the best-established genotype-drug pairing in cell-line pharmacology' with no citation and no accounting for zygosity/biallelic (LOH) status, which is the standard caveat for why BRCA-mutation-alone (vs. HRD score or confirmed biallelic loss) is a noisier predictor of PARP-inhibitor sensitivity in unselected pan-cancer cell-line panels than in engineered isogenic systems or BRCA-selected clinical cohorts. This doesn't change the paper's conclusion (the control is used to justify downgrading a null to 'uninformative', i.e. the more conservative reading, not to license a positive claim) but the framing overstates how surprising the control's non-detection is, and could be read as implying a stronger positive-control property than the underlying DepMap 'LikelyLoF' calls (used for the BRCA2 null arm, per research/modalities/atm-status-atri-stratification.json lines ~1829-1836) actually deliver absent LOH/zygosity filtering.
p1s.evidence: Manuscript, Part D (line ~678): 'BRCA2 against the two PARP inhibitors — the best-established genotype-drug pairing in cell-line pharmacology — is also undetectable here'. Source artifact `_machinery_control_note` (atm-status-atri-stratification.json, near line 2954) uses identical uncited framing: 'The best-established genotype-drug association in cell-line pharmacology, run through the IDENTICAL pipeline.' No zygosity/LOH field or discussion appears anywhere in the ~2970-line JSON artifact (grep for zygos|biallelic|LOH|heterozygous|homozygous returns nothing) or in the manuscript.
p1s.fix: Either cite the claim (e.g. Bryant et al. 2005 / Farmer et al. 2005 for the mechanism, plus a note that unselected pan-cancer panels show a weaker mutation-alone signal than isogenic/clinical settings), or soften to something like 'a well-established genotype-drug pairing' and add one clause noting the BRCA2 null arm is defined by DepMap's damaging/LikelyLoF calls without zygosity or LOH filtering, which is itself a limit on how strong a positive control this is expected to be even before considering arm size.

p1s.summary: The document's headline section (before Part D) states the mechanism's load-bearing prediction is testable 'only through ATM-pathway transcript abundance... and that proxy leaves no trace: ρ = −0.090' — this predates and does not mention the newer, more direct ATM-genetic-status stratification added later in §5, which is a second, independent (and better-motivated) test of the same load-bearing prediction and which itself returned UNINFORMATIVE rather than a clean null. A reader who stops at the headline would come away thinking the only instrument available for the ATM-signalling prediction is the expression proxy, when a genetic-status instrument now also exists (with its own, different limitation).
p1s.evidence: Headline (line ~105-107): 'The mechanism's load-bearing prediction — low ATM signalling marks ATRi sensitivity — is testable here only through ATM-pathway transcript abundance, which is not ATM signalling capacity, and that proxy leaves no trace: ρ = −0.090... carried by one drug of two (§5).' Compare §5 (line ~678): the newly added ATM-genotype stratification against the identical GDSC2 residuals, verdict INSTRUMENT_CANNOT_DETECT / UNINFORMATIVE. These are not contradictory (transcript abundance and genetic status are different variables, as §5 itself notes at line ~588 and 730-731), but the headline's 'only through' is no longer literally true of the document as a whole once §5's new analysis is counted, and the headline is the section most likely to be quoted stand-alone.
p1s.fix: Add a clause to the headline pointing at the new genetic-status stratification and its own UNINFORMATIVE verdict (one sentence), so 'testable here only through transcript abundance' is either qualified ('...only through transcript abundance for this correlation; a separate genetic-status test in §5 is also uninformative at these arm sizes, for a different reason') or the 'only' is removed.
